title: Return validation state through React 19 useActionState
businessContext: Review a focused Next.js application change before it reaches production. The proposed file below contains the defect or unsupported assumption; external application services, where imported, are integration boundaries.
problemStatement: Review the proposed app/contact-form.tsx change. Identify the incorrect framework assumption, propose a minimal corrected implementation, and provide evidence for the selected version scope and its 15/16 differences.
